item.title: AI Career Anxiety for Builders
item.description: Career anxiety in the AI era is not just about jobs. It is also about identity, apprenticeship, and the fear that the path to becoming valuable is changing.

item.title: What Part of AI Career Anxiety Is Economic vs Existential?
item.description: AI career anxiety is partly about jobs, but more deeply about apprenticeship, identity, status, and whether the old path to becoming valuable still holds.
